name: FUSES
text:
Are you looking for a fuse for your infrared sauna? You can buy a fuse here.

Besides fuses there are also fuse blocks and fuse holders, whether you want an upgrade or a replacement. If you have questions over which ones you should choose, contact us.

Fuses serve as a barrier to protect electrical systems from power surges. An infrared sauna contains a bunch of electrical parts, so fuses are indispensable.

We are looking forward to helping you fix or upgrade your infrared sauna!
text_short:
Protect your electronic devices against sudden voltage surges and overloading.
